title: Monotonicity of randomized reductions
statement: For any two classes of languages $\mathcal{C}$ and $\mathcal{D}$ with $\mathcal{C} \subseteq \mathcal{D}$, every language that reduces by a many-one reduction to some language in $\mathcal{C}$ also reduces by a many-one reduction to some language in $\mathcal{D}$.
